fixes.description: Replaced rail text glyphs with exact exported Figma SVG assets, explicit 19x19 geometry, active-state assets, route-aware selection, RTL/LTR placement, focus, and accessible links.
Added the bounded media dropzone, exact 22x22 Figma upload asset, accessible file input, and safe empty/media states without inventing contract fields.
Aligned AR/EN completion heading/description and shared content geometry with reviewed Provider source.
Asserted contact-only WhatsApp support and absence of secondary phone identity controls; no phone/password flow was added.
Made Public fixture assets follow WEB_BASE_URL on a non-default local port, fixing the proven lazy-image performance failure.

contracts.auth: Seeker/Provider remain email-only and passwordless; /auth/verify-email is canonical; /auth/verify-phone is browser-only legacy redirect; Admin auth remains outside this goal.
contracts.mapUrl: HTTPS absolute URLs only, max 2048; unsafe schemes rejected; locationId and coordinates preserved; no fetch/geocode/preview/synthesized coordinates.
contracts.projections: Unsupported Provider fields remain explicit unavailable/safe projections; no production data, CRM/internal notes, resolver fields, or Admin/private fields were fabricated.
contracts.uploads: Private media/documents remain owner-authorized, validated, rate-limited, signed, and redacted; PRV-08 uses an exact local Figma asset.
contracts.settings: Unsupported password/account-deletion actions remain disabled and fail closed; WhatsApp/office/website remain contact data, not identity.
